scripts.prisma:generate: mkdir -p apps/api/prisma && cp prisma/schema.prisma apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && cd apps/api && PRISMA_GENERATE_SKIP_AUTOINSTALL=1 pnpm exec prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:migrate: mkdir -p apps/api/prisma && cp prisma/schema.prisma apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && cd apps/api && PRISMA_GENERATE_SKIP_AUTOINSTALL=1 pnpm exec prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:seed: cd apps/api && pnpm exec tsx src/prisma/seed.ts
